description: Get the page where a person buys one specific eSIM plan, for an assistant to hand them a link. The page sells exactly this plan with Apple Pay, Google Pay and card, takes the email at payment, and sends the eSIM there. Nothing is charged or reserved by this call and the buyer needs no account. Use this whenever a PERSON is going to pay. Use create-checkout-session instead when the agent is settling the purchase itself, or for more than one plan or unit.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the price quoted back to you (e.g. "USD", "EUR"). Defaults to EUR. The page itself prices in the buyer's own currency.

plan_id.description: The plan id (a ULID) as returned by list-plans, get-plan or plan-trip.

source.description: The name of the assistant or app sending the buyer, recorded as the campaign source on the link (e.g. "claude"). Optional.

name: get-checkout-link

note.description: What the buyer will see on that page, in words you can repeat to them.

coverage_count.description: How many countries the plan works in.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code price_cents is quoted in, e.g. "EUR".

data_amount_mb.description: Full-speed allowance in megabytes; 1 GB is 1024 MB. 0 on an unlimited plan.

data_restriction_type.description: "limited" for a metered allowance, "unlimited" for one sold as uncapped.

id.description: The plan id (a 26-character ULID) this link buys.

name.description: Plan name as a traveller sees it, e.g. "Spain 5GB".

price_cents.description: Indicative price in minor units (cents) of the currency below, so 1250 is 12.50. The page prices live in the buyer's own currency and that is what is charged.

validity_days.description: Days the plan stays valid once activated.

url.description: The page to give the buyer. Opens the plan with Apple Pay, Google Pay and card on it. Safe to show to a person.

title: Get checkout link
